Kairat''' ({{langx|kk|«Қайрат» футбол клубы|«Qairat» futbol kluby}}) is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Almaty]], which plays in the [[Kazakhstan Premier League]], the highest level of [[Football in Kazakhstan|Kazakh football]]. Founded in 1954 as Lokomotiv Alma-Ata, they became Urozhay in 1955 and Kairat in 1956. The club's home ground is the [[Central Stadium (Almaty)|Central Stadium]] which has a capacity of 23,804 seats. The club's home kit colours are yellow and black striped shirts, black shorts and black socks. Kairat was the leading Kazakh club during the Soviet period and the only representative of the [[Kazakh Soviet Socialist Republic]] in the [[Soviet Top League]].{{Cite web|website=[[UEFA]]|author=Aidyn Kozhakhmetov|script-title=ru:"Кайрат": пять поводов для гордости|trans-title="Kairat": five reasons for pride|language=ru|url=https://ru.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0223-0e912f2b30cd-c0c2d6b82fd0-1000--%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82-/|date=8 July 2015|access-date=8 September 2017|archive-date=26 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190726135522/https://ru.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/newsid%3D2263988.html|url-status=live}} For this, Kairat became nicknamed ''The Nation's Team'', and remains widely supported all over the country.{{Cite web|website=sports.kz|script-title=ru:Кайрат Боранбаев: Кайрат — Народная команда. Так было всегда, и мы хотим это возродить|trans-title=Kairat Boranbayev: Kairat is the People's Team. It has always been so, and we want to revive it|language=ru|url=https://www.sports.kz/news/kayrat-boranbaev-kayrat-narodnaya-komanda-tak-byilo-vsegda-i-myi-hotim-eto-vozrodit/comment/1213957|date=3 March 2015|access-date=9 September 2017|archive-date=2 November 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221102130913/https://www.sports.kz/news/kayrat-boranbaev-kayrat-narodnaya-komanda-tak-byilo-vsegda-i-myi-hotim-eto-vozrodit/comment/1213957|url-status=live}} All in all, the club spent 24 seasons in the Soviet highest level. They also won [[Soviet First League]] titles twice, in 1976 and 1983. During this period, Kairat was a part of the [[Voluntary Sports Societies of the Soviet Union]]. In modern history, Kairat won five [[Kazakhstan Premier League|league]] titles, eight [[Kazakhstan Cup]]s and two [[Kazakhstan Super Cup]]s. The club's strongest rivalry is [[FC Astana]], among fans their matches are considered as the Two Capitals Derby.{{Cite web|publisher=Football Federation of Astana (FFA)|title=Two Capitals Derby: Astana Share Spoils With Kairat Thanks to Last-Gasp Equaliser|url=https://sportsffa.kz/kazakhstan-football/171212308-astana-kairat-share-spoils-2017-kpl-season-match-report/|author=Tlek Adryshev|date=2 May 2017|access-date=6 September 2017|archive-date=6 September 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170906180708/https://sportsffa.kz/kazakhstan-football/171212308-astana-kairat-share-spoils-2017-kpl-season-match-report/|url-status=dead}}"}}
